claims.text: Many reviewers praise the product for sensitive, eczema-prone, or reactive skin, saying it leaves skin soft and works when other products failed.
Reviewers frequently note that a very small amount goes a long way, making the higher price more acceptable.
Several reviewers report excellent customer service, including free replacements and prompt fixes for wrong or damaged orders.

Some reviewers warn about deceptive or inconsistent labeling and tampered products when purchased through Amazon, with broken seals and different consistency/smell than buying directly from the manufacturer.
A few reviewers mention the shampoo can leave adult hair greasy or oily when used alone.
